definition: A versioned bounded execution responsibility registered under this governance layer.
relation_to_ontology: Not an analytical domain or evidence object.
prohibited_confusion: Do not infer authority from the skill name.

definition: The immutable supplied skill name and version preserved as source evidence.
relation_to_ontology: Linked to but distinct from a canonical skill identity.
prohibited_confusion: Do not silently overwrite or relabel source text.

definition: The ontology-conforming identity used for future implementation and routing.
relation_to_ontology: May be a rename or one of several split successors.
prohibited_confusion: Do not treat source aliases as canonical.

definition: A semantic version for a skill specification or implementation.
relation_to_ontology: Independent of ontology version and schema version.
prohibited_confusion: Do not reuse a version after semantic change.

definition: The bounded responsibility a skill may perform.
relation_to_ontology: Constrains activation and output objects.
prohibited_confusion: Do not use broad topical descriptions as authority.

definition: VERBATIM, SPEC_RECOVERED, or SPEC_RECONSTRUCTED source-history classification.
relation_to_ontology: Orthogonal to evidence tiers T1–T4.
prohibited_confusion: Never convert specification provenance into evidentiary strength.

definition: Skill body preserved as byte-identical or text-identical source material.
relation_to_ontology: Specification provenance only.
prohibited_confusion: Does not imply correctness or current authority.

definition: Skill body recovered from a preserved design session or source record.
relation_to_ontology: Specification provenance only.
prohibited_confusion: Does not imply evidentiary confidence.

definition: Skill body reconstructed from catalog identity and shared contracts.
relation_to_ontology: Specification provenance only.
prohibited_confusion: Must not be represented as an original verbatim specification.

definition: Design, authorization, implementation, quarantine, template, or retirement disposition of a skill identity.
relation_to_ontology: Includes revised design pending authorization, quarantined legacy, template only, and retired states.
prohibited_confusion: Do not equate lifecycle state with execution status.

definition: Whether an implemented skill may currently be routed or invoked.
relation_to_ontology: Separate from lifecycle and registration.
prohibited_confusion: Design approval alone never activates runtime.

definition: Rules determining whether a skill owns and may accept a task.
relation_to_ontology: Includes required inputs, explicit triggers, conflicts, and non-activation conditions.
prohibited_confusion: Topical similarity alone is insufficient.

definition: Explicit side-effect permissions granted to a run.
relation_to_ontology: Read, artifact, patch, repository, send, promotion, merge, and release permissions are separate.
prohibited_confusion: Authority is not inherited from an orchestrator or prior run.

definition: Maximum authority a skill implementation may ever exercise.
relation_to_ontology: A run grant must be at or below the ceiling.
prohibited_confusion: A ceiling is not an active grant.

definition: Task-specific authorization for named side effects.
relation_to_ontology: Bound to a run, target, and scope.
prohibited_confusion: Do not infer from user identity, repository access, or skill name.

definition: Versioned record of one attempted skill execution.
relation_to_ontology: Contains stages, inputs, configuration, authority, data mode, and terminal status.
prohibited_confusion: Do not mutate completed runs in place.

definition: Named bounded step within an execution run.
relation_to_ontology: Stages may produce checkpoints and failures.
prohibited_confusion: Do not report a skipped stage as completed.

definition: completed, partial, blocked, or failed.
relation_to_ontology: Matches the supplied skill output contract.
prohibited_confusion: Do not collapse blocked into failed or partial into completed.

definition: Mutually exclusive disposition totals for all supplied inputs.
relation_to_ontology: total = accepted + rejected + duplicate + review + unresolved.
prohibited_confusion: Do not omit inaccessible or unsupported inputs.

definition: Structured record of a failed stage, class, affected scope, checkpoint, and corrective action.
relation_to_ontology: Preserves partial work without claiming completion.
prohibited_confusion: Do not hide errors in free-text limitations only.

definition: Verified restart boundary bound to input and state hashes.
relation_to_ontology: May support deterministic resume.
prohibited_confusion: Do not resume from an unverified or incompatible checkpoint.

definition: Explicit transfer from one skill or owner to another with artifacts and unresolved assumptions.
relation_to_ontology: Required at analytical ownership boundaries.
prohibited_confusion: A handoff does not transfer authority automatically.

definition: Machine-readable completion record paired with a concise human result.
relation_to_ontology: Binds status, accounting, outputs, evidence, validation, limitations, and next action.
prohibited_confusion: Do not claim output absent from the receipt.

definition: Declared source condition: canonical live, authorized archived, authorized cache, stale, demo, synthetic, or unknown.
relation_to_ontology: Independent of evidence tier and visibility class.
prohibited_confusion: No silent fallback across modes.

definition: Current canonical data resolved from the authorized source.
relation_to_ontology: A data mode, not a truth guarantee.
prohibited_confusion: Do not infer completeness or correctness.

definition: Archived source explicitly allowed for the task.
relation_to_ontology: Must carry coverage and end dates.
prohibited_confusion: Do not describe as current.

definition: Cached data explicitly allowed and age-bounded.
relation_to_ontology: Must record cache timestamp and source identity.
prohibited_confusion: Do not silently substitute for live data.

definition: Data older than the task-specific freshness requirement.
relation_to_ontology: May support historical context only.
prohibited_confusion: Do not use for present-state claims without qualification.

definition: Demonstration material not representing canonical operational data.
relation_to_ontology: Must be isolated and labeled.
prohibited_confusion: Do not promote into canonical outputs.

definition: Generated test or simulation data.
relation_to_ontology: May validate behavior but not factual claims.
prohibited_confusion: Do not mix silently with real records.

definition: Disclosure and handling category for run inputs and outputs.
relation_to_ontology: Public, internal, private, restricted, secret-bearing, or credential-bearing.
prohibited_confusion: Do not lower classification through transformation.

definition: Allowed scheduling mode and temporal constraints for a skill.
relation_to_ontology: On-demand, scheduled, event-triggered, or release-gate.
prohibited_confusion: A cadence declaration does not create a schedule.

definition: Non-analytical skill that routes work and reconciles receipts.
relation_to_ontology: Must invoke analytical owners instead of producing their findings.
prohibited_confusion: Cannot inherit or amplify component authority.

definition: Analytical output carrying its canonical domain owner and object type.
relation_to_ontology: Required before cross-domain assembly.
prohibited_confusion: Do not relabel an output to avoid a handoff.

definition: Explicit list of ontology object types and separately classified subtype labels allowed as skill inputs or outputs.
relation_to_ontology: Each subtype is marked ONTOLOGY_CANONICAL or SKILL_GOVERNANCE_SUBTYPE; the latter does not extend ontology v2.0.
prohibited_confusion: Do not promote a skill-governance subtype into an ontology term or schema without separate ontology authority.

definition: Preserved non-canonical identity accepted for search or compatibility.
relation_to_ontology: Maps to one or more canonical successors.
prohibited_confusion: Must not override canonical ownership.

definition: Canonical identity replacing or splitting a source skill.
relation_to_ontology: Carries a declared relation and migration rationale.
prohibited_confusion: Do not imply source artifacts were rewritten.

definition: Bounded adapter preserving historical commands or files.
relation_to_ontology: May translate to canonical contracts.
prohibited_confusion: Must not emit new unqualified canonical findings.

definition: Named deterministic check with pass/fail result and evidence.
relation_to_ontology: Recorded in a receipt.
prohibited_confusion: Do not substitute an assertion for execution evidence.

definition: Failure record, partial artifacts, checkpoint, limitations, and corrective action returned when completion is impossible.
relation_to_ontology: Preferred over fabricated completion.
prohibited_confusion: Must not be labeled completed.

definition: Workflow queue ordering only.
relation_to_ontology: Orthogonal to confidence, evidence tier, recurrence, and truth.
prohibited_confusion: Do not use as evidence strength.

definition: Governed state transition requiring explicit authority and a named gate.
relation_to_ontology: Separate from analysis and validation.
prohibited_confusion: No skill may promote by default.

definition: One bounded continuation step stated in a receipt.
relation_to_ontology: May be a handoff, correction, or human decision.
prohibited_confusion: Not an operational recommendation for live or physical action.
